_instructions: Copy this file to config/config.json and replace every value below. Then run: uv run python run_pipeline.py

_notes.duckdb_memory_limit: optional, step 04 only: add a top-level key such as "duckdb_memory_limit": "8GB" to cap DuckDB memory; without it DuckDB uses up to 80% of RAM
_notes.timezone: The timezone your hospital is in. One of: US/Eastern, US/Central, US/Mountain, US/Arizona, US/Pacific, US/Alaska, US/Hawaii. Not UTC
